exposure: breech presentation of the first twin
outcome: neonatal morbidity (5-minute Apgar score < 7, cord pH < 7.10 at birth, sepsis, acute respiratory distress syndrome
cohort: 184 twin pregnancies where the first twin was in breech presentation and delivery was after 32 weeks of gestation
finding: Planned vaginal delivery for twin pregnancies with the first twin in breech presentation was not associated with increased neonatal morbidity and was associated with a lower rate of postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Planned vaginal delivery for twin pregnancies with the first twin in breech presentation was associated with a lower rate of postpartum hemorrhage.
